enchantment.simpleriding.tailwind.desc: Increases ridden mount speed. Server defaults per level: horses 30%, other mounts and nautiluses 20%, Happy Ghasts 85%; level III maximum.
enchantment.simpleriding.leaping.desc: Increases ridden horse jump strength or nautilus dash strength. Server default: +20% per level; level III maximum.

setting; restart required.
